extracted.intended_audience: authors submitting manuscripts to Statistical Science (IMS journal)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines for preparing and electronically submitting manuscripts to the journal Statistical Science (Institute of Mathematical Statistics), including LaTeX/template requirements, authorship/affiliation rules, acknowledgement policy, referee suggestions, and supplemental material handling.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission of Papers
rubrics_metrics.description: Submission of a manuscript implies (a) that the same work has not been published before; (b) that it is not under consideration for publication elsewhere; and (c) that its publication has been approved by all co-authors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors must ensure originality, exclusivity of submission, and co-author approval prior to submitting. Submission signals agreement with these conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Electronic submission via EJMS
rubrics_metrics.description: All submissions to Statistical Science must be made electronically through the IMS’s Electronic Journal Management System (EJMS).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors should access https://www.e-publications.org/ims/submission/. First-time users must complete registration (only once). As a registered user you will be able to upload your manuscript as a PDF file.

rubrics_metrics.name: Referee suggestions and contact
rubrics_metrics.description: If desired, you may use the “Comments to the editor” box to suggest referees who are experts in fields relevant for the submitted paper with the understanding that the editors, along with the associate editors, may or may not choose to utilize the suggestions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Do not canvass or directly contact the suggested referees about your paper. Use the comments box only for suggestions; editors retain final choice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Style: LaTeX and STS template
rubrics_metrics.description: Manuscripts must be written in LaTeX using STS’s template.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The template will set proper margins and font. Use the provided sample.pdf and sample.tex files to prepare a camera-ready paper in LaTeX. These documents contain useful information regarding the structure of your document, proper tagging style, layout features, etc. Please do not use any packages or commands that affect the layout or formatting of your document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Affiliations and Addresses
rubrics_metrics.description: Please list one affiliation per author.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If an author has more than one affiliation, the additional affiliations should be listed in the Acknowledgments section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acknowledgement Policy
rubrics_metrics.description: Acknowledgements should be limited to referencing specific kinds of contributors and support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptable acknowledgements include: (a) named individuals who have contributed to the research by providing tangible inputs such as ideas, feedback, or code; (b) possibly-anonymous individuals who have served in the paper’s evaluation via the refereeing and editorial process; (c) organizations that provided funding; and/or (d) scientific institutions or meetings where the research was conducted or facilitated, if other than the home institution of an author.

rubrics_metrics.name: Supplemental Material
rubrics_metrics.description: If your paper has supplemental material please follow the instructions here.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Authors with supplemental material must follow the journal's supplemental material instructions (linked from the manuscript preparation page). Ensure supplemental files conform to the journal's format and submission process.
